Biggest leaks (estimated, overlapping, not additive)
  1. Repeated tool results: ~$4.50 (estimated), 60K tokens (estimated)
     Do this: duplicate_result_collapser = "on"
     Add this line under [optimizers] in config.toml. It applies from your next
     session.
  2. Noisy tool output: ~$3.00 (estimated), 90K tokens (estimated)
     Do this: trove optimize status
     noise_normalizer can remove this. It is not offered yet: Trove needs more
     sessions to be sure it is worth it.
  3. Prompt cache misses: ~$1.35 (estimated), 27K tokens (estimated)
     Cache misses happen when the start of a request changes between turns.
     Avoid editing early context mid-session.

Optimizers
  model_router: off
  effort_tool_turns: off
  effort_routine_prompts: off
  volatile_prefix_mover: off
  noise_normalizer: off
    Saved ~$0.50 (estimated).
  output_trimmer: off
  duplicate_result_collapser: off
    Would have saved ~$3.60 (estimated, shadow mode).
    To turn on, add under [optimizers] in config.toml:
    duplicate_result_collapser = "on"
  verbosity_steer: off
  thinking_clear: off
  cache_breakpoints: off
  Guardrail events: none.
  No regression check yet: not enough finished sessions with an optimizer on to
  compare.

Third-party tools (each tool's own claim next to what Trove measured)
  rtk v1.1.0: on (license Apache-2.0, permissive)
    Claimed by the tool  "reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev
                         commands" (https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk; not checked
                         by Trove)
    Measured by Trove    in a randomized test, with it on: tokens per session
                         -40.0% (95% range -41.6% to -38.3%), measured; share of
                         the weekly limit per session -40.0% (95% range -41.7%
                         to -38.3%), -0.013 points of the weekly limit per
                         session (95% range -0.014 to -0.013), estimated from
                         API prices; pass rate -25.0 points (95% range -37.5 to
                         -12.5; 40 and 40 sessions that ran tests), measured (40
                         sessions on, 40 off)
    Overhead: 0 tokens on every request while on (estimated; declared). It is
    part of every prompt, so the measured figures above already include it.
    Each new session was given the tool or not at random (trove hook handoff),
    so the two groups differ only by chance and by the tool. Method:
    docs/benchmark-methodology.md section 11.

A/B results (measured: whole sessions with an optimizer on versus in shadow)
  Shadow estimates above are estimated; shadow mode cannot see behaviour changes
  such as retries, extra turns or re-reads. These A/B figures compare real cost
  and outcomes, so they can be lower than a shadow estimate or than other tools'
  claims.
  ext_rtk: not enough data yet
    not enough data yet: 0 sessions with it on and 0 with it off so far; each
      side needs at least 20 (sessions with it on: 0, off: 0)

Recommendations (suggestions only; Trove changes nothing on its own)
  None yet. These need more recorded usage.
